propositions: Grounding harness tests emit DeprecationWarning when executing under xdist workers because the test suite is multithreaded and fork-context multiprocessing is hard-coded for POSIX hosts
src/rebar/grounding/harness.py:254-267 unconditionally uses multiprocessing.get_context("fork") which calls os.fork() in a multithreaded environment, triggering the CPython 3.12 deprecation warning

run_in_worker and its public re-export require unpicklable closures and lambdas under the current fork semantics, creating a caller-dependency contract that prevents transparent switch to spawn context
Spawn-context process creation eliminates the deprecation warning but breaks tests with unpicklable fixtures that mutate Process objects before start
The repair must preserve timeout, cleanup, and child-process isolation guarantees across POSIX and non-POSIX platforms while enforcing a callable picklability contract for public callers
